opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead email to hiring
opportunities.description: Look up a GitHub user's profile and top repo, then draft a lead email to hiring@example.com for a given role, summarizing followers, top repo stars and language, and latest post.
steps: Open GitHub and click 'Search or jump to'
Type the GitHub username and press Enter
Click the 'Users' filter in the results sidebar
Note follower count; open the top pinned repo and note stars and language
Note the user's latest blog post or activity
Open mail compose; set To = hiring@example.com
Set Body = '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {latest_post}.'
Send, or Discard as the user did

instances.values: username=karpathy, role=ML Research Engineer, repo=nanoGPT (63.8k stars, Python), 226k followers
username=gaearon, role=Staff Frontend Engineer, repo=react/react (251.0k stars, JavaScript), 94k followers
username=simonw, role=Developer Advocate, repo=llm (12.6k stars, Python), 17.3k followers

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person + Wayback snapshot of their organization's site, saved to notes
opportunities.description: Search Wikipedia for a person to get key facts, open a Wayback Machine snapshot of their organization's website for a given year, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for the person's name and press Enter
Read birth date and current role from the article
Open the Wayback Machine and enter the organization's domain, then press Enter
Select the target year in the timeline and click a capture date
In Notes, add a new note: '{person}: born {date}, {role}. {domain} in {year}: {headline}.'

instances.values: person=Satya Nadella, domain=microsoft.com, year=2014 (completed with note)
person=Jacinda Ardern, domain=beehive.govt.nz (archive snapshot kept reloading; no note seen)
person=Tim Berners-Lee (archive kept reloading; no note seen)
